metadata.description: Personal user-scope Claude Code skills: internal-ca (2-tier PKI bootstrap), mtls (server-trusts-client mTLS), lxd-claude-setup (headless Claude Code setup on LXD/Linux), a bare-metal Kubernetes family — k8s-bare-metal (kubeadm + Rancher, single-node/HA/join), harbor-registry (private Harbor with self-signed CA), cicd-platform (Argo CD + self-hosted Actions runners) — and the MJBL mTLS platform suite (live deployed ecosystem on this host: platform/ca/enrollment/client/cert-lifecycle/operator-portal/troubleshooting, indexing the /home/mjbl/* runbooks). Plus the MJBL Kubernetes estate suite under /mjbl:k8s:* (platform, prod, facility, dr): the multi-cluster topology (prod rkek8s, facility/ArgoCD, UAT, DR), kubeconfigs, MetalLB, ArgoCD external-cluster deploys, and the kubectl-apply DR tooling. Plus wealthcorp-rancher-proxmox: the WealthCorp Rancher-on-Proxmox node-provisioning environment (pvenode driver, pve01, the wealth-cluster mgmt cluster) and its etcd-disk reliability root cause + gotchas. MJBL internal LLM platform: mjbl-llm-platform (the staff AI assistant + MaaS gateway on the facility cluster — one hostname serving Open WebUI at / and an OpenAI-compatible API at /v1, the yanmaru/shinkhoun/noy/kanshin/phima model aliases on the LM Studio rig, AD login, model-scoped API keys, the bge-m3 retrieval posture, and the silent-failure traps), exposed as the /mjbl:llm:platform slash command.
